data.gender_notes: Yashvi is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Yashvi is derived from the Sanskrit word 'yasas' which means prosperity and victory. In Hindu mythology, Yashvi is believed to be the goddess of prosperity and good fortune. The name Yashvi carries the meaning “Goddess of prosperity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit. Parents who choose Yashvi usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of prosperity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the divine grace and blessings of the goddess of prosperity and good fortune.
data.etymology: Yashvi belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of prosperity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Yashvi total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
